instruction: Please update VS Code settings to hide all "node_modules" folders from the file explorer.

metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding node_modules folders in VS Code explorer. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify files.exclude setting contains '**/node_modules': true. Similar complexity to original task - single setting modification.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correct: get_vm_file properly extracts VS Code settings from standard location /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric logic correct: check_json_settings (vscode.py:49-77) properly validates expected key-value pairs exist in JSON with correct comparison logic
Expected value semantically correct: {'files.exclude': {'**/node_modules': true}} is the exact VS Code setting needed to hide node_modules folders from file explorer
Complete coverage: evaluator directly verifies the required setting with no missing requirements

State accessibility: settings.json is persistent file on disk, not UI-dependent. Rule validator warning about UI dependency is false positive - settings are saved to file and accessible without reopening UI
Data flow correct: file getter -> JSON parsing -> key-value comparison works correctly at runtime
Parameter handling correct: metric accesses expected['expected'] (line 67) which is correct for type='rule' (get_rule returns config['rules'], so metric receives {'expected': {...}})
Postconfig appropriately closes VS Code window, though not strictly necessary since settings.json is persistent

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
